03Anything

Clothing, gadgets, beauty, furniture, games, bots, whole apps. If you can link it, photograph it or describe it, Remintpad can take it apart.

Every top model works on your build. Drag the sliders to decide how much of the thinking each one does.

05Money

Where the money goes.

Three flows, all on-chain and all visible. Fees pay for the work, sales pay the holders, and burns buy more power.

Sales pay holders

When your product sells, the profit splits between holders and buybacks of your coin. You set the split at launch.

Holders 50%Buyback 50%

Burn for more power

Burn $REMINT to give your build extra compute. Every 100,000 burned adds one hour of priority agent time.
